title: ComfyUI Official Changelog v0.21.1
claims: v0.21.1 on 2026-05-13 added Flux2ImageNode, GrokImageEditNodeV2, ByteDanceSeedreamNodeV2, OpenAI Image node DynamicCombo/Autogrow, Claude LLM node, Anima TE LoRA Kohya support, HiDream-O1-Image fixes, LTXV guide alignment fix.
aiwf_use: Update compatibility matrix; classify partner/API nodes separately from local model nodes; add fast-moving API-node warnings to RAG.

title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI README
claims: ComfyUI is a modular AI engine; supports latest open-source models; API nodes expose closed-source models; App Mode can expose sophisticated workflows through a simple UI; API endpoints support production pipelines.
aiwf_use: Confirms AIWF should build wrappers, manifests, workflows, and education around ComfyUI instead of cloning the UI.

title: ComfyUI Official Workflow JSON Schema
claims: ComfyUI workflow JSON is defined by JSON Schema; latest workflow schema version is 1.0; changes route through the rfcs repo.
aiwf_use: Use schema-aware workflow validation instead of string patching; keep workflow packs version-tagged.

title: RunComfy Workflow Files / object_info documentation
claims: workflow_api.json is node-ID keyed with inputs, class_type, and optional _meta; object_info.json catalogs node required/optional inputs, accepted types/ranges, outputs, tooltips, and metadata.
aiwf_use: Capture /object_info from local ComfyUI to build compatibility manifests, validate generated JSON, and generate node cards automatically.

title: ComfyUI Official Subgraph Feature Documentation
claims: Subgraphs package complex workflows into reusable subgraph nodes; require frontend 1.24.3+; v0.3.66+ supports direct parameter-panel editing; 1.27.7+ supports publishing subgraph blueprints to the node library.
aiwf_use: Use subgraphs as the UI strategy for mega-workflows and AIWF teaching modules, while keeping original node chains inspectable in source workflows.

title: ComfyUI Official Partial Execution Documentation
claims: Partial Execution runs only part of a workflow, starting through the selected output branch; it requires selecting an output node and a compatible frontend version after the v1.24.x fix.
aiwf_use: Design compare workflows with separate Preview/Save outputs per branch so users can test restore, inpaint, face, and upscale modules independently.

title: ComfyUI API Nodes Wave 2
claims: API Nodes Wave 2 positioned LLM nodes as workflow-internal tools for writing, reasoning, prompt generation, logic branches, and multi-step chains across nodes.
aiwf_use: Supports the AIWF Knowledge Pack idea: LLM-assisted prompt rewrite and workflow control should be documented as an optional API/local-agent layer, not fused into every workflow.
